user.title: Set up NBE StokerCloud
user.description: Use the same user name and password you use on https://v16.stokercloud.dk/. The password is required: it gives the integration full access so it can change setpoints.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter StokerCloud password
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the StokerCloud password for {username}. From version 3 the integration only uses the authenticated (user + password) API.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong user name or password, or the account has no write access.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This StokerCloud account is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: Maximum time between full data fetches. Minimum 30 seconds.
data_description.calorific_value: Used for the Pellet Energy sensor. EN-plus wood pellets are about 4.8 kWh/kg.
data_description.fast_updates: Check every 10 seconds whether the boiler has sent new data, and fetch it right away. The controller reports about once a minute.
data_description.low_hopper_kg: Hopper Low turns on at or below this amount when you track the hopper content.
data_description.import_statistics: Adds pellet consumption (kg) and energy (kWh) history as long-term statistics, for the Energy dashboard.

set_value.name: Set controller value
set_value.description: Write any numeric controller setting, like the StokerCloud web settings pages do. The value is checked against the min/max the controller reports.

config_entry_id.name: StokerCloud entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one StokerCloud account is configured.

setting.name: Setting
setting.description: Setting id, for example boiler.temp, boiler.diff_under, hot_water.diff_under, hopper.content or regulation.boiler_power_max.

value.name: Value
value.description: New value, in the unit shown on the StokerCloud website.
